newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday on small buying by textile mills and the trend is likely to continue on Tuesday owing to a reduced selling pressure from ginners, brokers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
The prices fluctuated slightly in the kerb market where mills with ready cash could buy at a slightly lower rate than paid for buying on credit, broker Girdharilal Lakhwani said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted 2,100/2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 2,450/2,475 and the MNH-93 2,460/2,485, he said.
